newsproject package¶

Submodules¶

newsproject.asgi module¶

ASGI config for newsproject, used by async-capable servers.

newsproject.settings module¶

Django settings for the News Application (newsproject).

Configures the custom user model, Django REST Framework token authentication, MariaDB/MySQL as the primary database (with an SQLite fallback for testing via USE_SQLITE=1), and the console email backend used for approval notifications during development.

newsproject.urls module¶

Top-level URL configuration for the newsproject Django project.

Wires up the admin site, authentication views, the newsapp browser views, and the newsapp REST API under the /api/ prefix.

newsproject.wsgi module¶

WSGI config for newsproject, used by gunicorn and other WSGI servers.
